title: Refresh coordination and crash consistency
scope: FastMCP 4359485; selected MCP SDK environments and PR #3278 base/head.
evidence_state: Retained historical results and source analysis; per-row status and limits apply.
interpretation: This matrix indexes existing evidence. Rows are not additional tests, and no structural or security closure is inferred from a PASS count.

rows.invariant: If a deployment requires serialized refresh, sharing storage must not be mistaken for a shared live lock.
rows.oracle: Retained observation summary and source analysis.
rows.observed: Separate live OAuth contexts sharing storage did not serialize the first colliding refresh; one reauthorized, later cycles used different pairs.
rows.limits: Owned provider rotation policy; no exactly-once guarantee established

rows.invariant: If atomic state is required, an interrupted save must not mix token generations.
rows.scenario: Controlled exit between token-pair and expiry writes.
rows.oracle: Retained observation summary and source analysis.
rows.observed: Controlled process exit between token and expiry writes left new token pair with prior expiry; SQLite valid; explicit retry repaired test state.
rows.limits: Historical controlled interruption, not proof of natural exploit or automatic recovery
